verdict.rationale: The docs show documents can be added to an existing index, and first-party sync integrations (Meilisync database sync, Rails ActiveRecord auto-sync, Firebase sync) imply incremental updates without a full reindex. However, no evidence explicitly documents update/delete semantics or near-real-time visibility. Community reports are mixed: one production user saw indexing of 50k constantly changing records fall behind for hours, while others report large indexing-speed gains and that batch indexing fixed earlier throughput problems. Missing for 10: explicit docs on incremental update/delete operations, documented latency until changes become searchable, and consistent hands-on evidence of near-real-time freshness under high change rates.
